Comment.Paragraph: Protocols: Cell line isolated from patient tumor. Cells were plated in DMEM/F12 (Thermo Fisher, cat. no 11320033), supplemented with 20ng/ml human Epidermal Growth Factor (EGF) (Thermo Fisher, cat. no PHG0311), 10ng/ml human FGF-basic (AA10-155) (Thermo Fisher, cat. no PHG0023), B27 supplemented (1X) (Thermo Fisher, cat no. 12587010) and 1% penicillin-streptomycin (Thermo Fisher, cat. no. 15140122). Cells were plated onto plates prior coated with Collagen I (Coating Matrix Kit (Thermo Fisher, cat no. R011K) in accordance to manufacturer protocol. Nuclei were lysed in 50 mM HEPES-KOH, 150 mM NaCl, 2 mM EDTA, 1% Triton X-100, 0.1% deoxycholate, 1% SDS supplemented with protease inhibitors (Calbiochem) for 15 minutes at 4°C followed by centrifugation at 20 000rpm for 30 minutes at 4oC. Pelleted chromatin was then sheared on ice to a size of approximately 400bp using a probe sonicator (Branson digital sonifier S-450D). Chromatin extracts were precleared at 20,000rpm for 45 minutes in 4°C and the chromatin solution was collected for immunoprecipitation (IP). ChIP-seq library was prepared using the NEB Next® ChIP-Seq Library kit (NEB Biolabs) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
